name: velocity-for-shopify
description: Manage sales reps, teams, customer ownership, and commissions in Velocity for your Shopify store.

interface.longDescription:
Velocity is a Shopify app for B2B brands that sell through sales reps: manufacturers, distributors, and wholesalers whose field and inside reps manage accounts and place orders. Velocity calculates commission on every order. It pays reps by account ownership or by territory, and pays each manager above them on the team.

With Velocity for Shopify, ChatGPT can manage your sales team:
- Reps: add, update, enable, or disable reps.
- Rep Portal access: give reps a portal login, change what they can see, or remove access.
- Teams: get the rep and manager structure of each team.
- Account ownership: assign Shopify customers, companies, and locations to reps.
- Commissions: find commissions by rep, order, or date range.

Velocity identifies customers, companies, locations, and orders by their Shopify IDs. Connect Shopify to look up their names.

Requires the Velocity Premium plan: https://apps.shopify.com/velocity-commission-maps
defaultPrompt: Show last month's commissions by rep.
Who are the reps and managers on each of my teams?
Which customers and companies does each rep own?

positive.prompt: What sales teams do I have in Velocity?
Show the reps and managers on my first team.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the team's rep levels, with each rep under their manager.

positive.prompt: Show last month's commissions, grouped by rep.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists commissions on last month's orders, with a total for each rep and manager.

positive.prompt: Which customers, companies, and locations do the reps on my first team own?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists each owned customer, company, or location ID with the name of the rep who owns it.

positive.description: Create a rep with Rep Portal access
positive.prompt: Add a new rep named Taylor Reviewer with the email taylor.reviewer@example.com, and give them a Rep Portal login.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the rep, gives them a Rep Portal login, and confirms the rep's name and email.

negative.description: Request unrelated to sales reps or commissions
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Chicago today?
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call any Velocity tools.

negative.description: Shopify order change that Velocity does not do
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call any Velocity tools. Says that Velocity cannot refund or change Shopify orders.

negative.description: Commission payout that Velocity does not do
negative.prompt: Pay my reps their commissions for last month.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call any Velocity write tools. Says that Velocity calculates commissions but does not send payments.
